entries.name: sum_join_no_matches

entries.name: count_three_way_chain_join

entries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM T_AJ24 a, T_AJ25 b, T_AJ26 c WHERE a.b_id = b.b_id AND b.c_id = c.c_id
